bullets: Build backend platform endpoints and features in Python/FastAPI, plus end-to-end test suites covering full request paths.
Refactor core UI library components and maintain Storybook docs for shared internal products.
Use AI coding tools daily to speed up delivery and raise code-review quality.
Architected a centralized API gateway platform — JWT auth, versioning, rate limiting and security policies — with resilient retry-based integrations to external systems.
Led the Vue 2 → Vue 3 migration and co-created a PrimeVue + Tailwind design system adopted by 3 internal apps.
Aligned API contracts with backend engineers and integrated deeply nested GraphQL APIs for complex product data models.
Profiled and fixed performance bottlenecks in data-heavy views; led a PIM redesign that cut support requests and improved onboarding completion.

about.lead: Senior software engineer with 9+ years shipping full-stack systems and API platforms — now pairing that with heavy day-to-day use of LLMs and AI tooling to design, review and ship faster.
about.body: I've owned services end to end: API gateways, PostgreSQL schemas, NestJS/FastAPI backends, Vue frontends, Docker and CI/CD pipelines. Day to day that now includes AI experiments and LLM-assisted workflows — from evaluating model output to using AI coding tools as a daily driver across the stack.
about.nowValue: Senior Software Engineer at The Codest, building full-stack features.
about.lookingValue: Software Engineer roles where I can own real product work end to end, with AI tooling as part of the craft.
about.outsideValue: Mountain trails and morning runs — best debugging happens off-screen.
